  SELECT t, value,
         regexp_full_match(coalesce(labels['schemaname'], ''), ('${schema_name:regex}')) AS s, coalesce(labels['schemaname'], '') = '*' AS s_all,
         regexp_full_match(coalesce(labels['indexrelname'], ''), ('${index_name:regex}')) AS i, coalesce(labels['indexrelname'], '') = '*' AS i_all,
         regexp_full_match(coalesce(labels['datname'], ''), ('${datname:regex}')) AS d, coalesce(labels['datname'], '') = '*' AS d_all
  FROM x
), p AS (
  SELECT t, value,
         CASE WHEN s AND i AND d THEN 8 WHEN s AND i AND d_all THEN 7 WHEN s AND i_all AND d THEN 6
              WHEN s_all AND i AND d THEN 5 WHEN s_all AND i_all AND d THEN 4 WHEN s AND i_all AND d_all THEN 3
              WHEN s_all AND i AND d_all THEN 2 WHEN s_all AND i_all AND d_all THEN 1 END AS prio
  FROM m
)
SELECT t, value FROM (SELECT t, max(value * prio) / max(prio) AS value FROM p WHERE prio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t)
WHERE NOT isnan(value)
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, 'index_rebuild_scale_factor' AS __series, '1' AS __sid
FROM q
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
